_comment: 15 PR/diff review queries (should trigger), plus 5 decoys that are about reading docs, authoring, or codebase overviews instead of reviewing a diff.

queries.query: Review my PR against main — what changed and is it safe to merge?
Explain this git diff I just ran: git diff main..HEAD
Summarize the changes in this branch since it diverged from main.
Audit my pull request for security issues — especially auth-related changes.
Check my branch diff for anything risky before I merge.
Look at git diff main..HEAD and tell me what I should flag in review.
What did I change between main and HEAD? Walk me through the diff.
Run a code review on my current branch.
Is this pull request ready for review? Go through the changes.
The diff against main is large — help me understand it without wading through lockfile changes.
Explain my PR at a high level: what did it change and why might it be risky?
Summarize the delta from the last release tag to HEAD.
Review the commits I pushed today.
git diff output is hard to read — help me review this change.
Look at my branch's changes versus main and flag anything sensitive to billing or auth.
Write a new git hook that lints before commit.
Read /workspace/fixtures/large-doc.md and summarize it.
Give me an overview of the codebase at /workspace.
What is a merge commit?
Explain how git rebase works conceptually.
